# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** nine years old  <sub>[v3 c18 P9](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0009)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c8 P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Student and aspiring farmer / storekeeper  <sub>[v2 c14 P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v4 c4 P8](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0008)</sub>

## Appearance

Davy is a fair-complexioned lad with a round head covered in a crop of fuzzy little yellow ringlets. He has roguish, elf-like hazel eyes, a snub nose, and a smile featuring a single dimple in one cheek that gives him a comical, lopsided look when he laughs. Over time, he has grown visibly taller, proudly matching his schoolmate Milty Boulter in height.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v3 c40 P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006)_

## Personality

Davy is energetic, inquisitive, and mischievous, possessing a lively curiosity that frequently leads him to ask endless questions. He is practical and lacks imagination, though he possesses a natural knack for winning love. Although he can be heedless, forgetful, and disobedient, he eventually reforms from his early unruly behavior. He dislikes church and often takes comfort when misfortunes are shared.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c18 P3](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0003), [v2 c24 P52](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0052), [v2 c26 P31](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0031), [v3 c14 P43](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0043), [v4 c4 P7](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0007)_

## History

Davy Keith and his twin sister Dora were orphaned when their sick mother, Mary, passed away. Being third cousins to Marilla Cuthbert, the twins were taken in at Green Gables. Davy's lack of early training and upbringing initially resulted in great distraction and constant mischief, such as shutting Dora up, telling lies, falling into lemon pies, and hanging over the well to look for the dark. Under Anne Shirley's affectionate guidance and Marilla's firm discipline, Davy gradually reformed. He started attending Avonlea school, where he shared a desk with Milty Boulter and developed a keen rivalry over their height. As he grew older, Davy developed a strong interest in farming and expressed a desire to try running the Green Gables farm.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 c9 P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 c10 P61](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0061), [v2 c17 P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c26 P31](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0031), [v3 c40 P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006), [v4 c4 P8](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0008)_

## Background by volume

- Lost his father when he was a baby  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033)</sub>
- Never had proper upbringing during early childhood due to his mother's illness  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c10 P61](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0061)</sub>
- Associated with Mr. Sprott's untruthful children before moving to Green Gables  <sub>[v2 c10 P53](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0053), [v2 c10 P61](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0061)</sub>
- Went without cake for a long time during his mother's illness  <sub>[v2 c8 P13](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0013)</sub>
- Spoke with his mother the night before she died  <sub>[v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008)</sub>
- Scoured with hard soap by Mrs. Wiggins on the day of his mother's funeral  <sub>[v2 c8 P31](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0031)</sub>
- Neglected to say his prayers for over a week to test a warning  <sub>[v2 c10 P70](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0070)</sub>
- Cut up all of Dora's aprons after being forced to wear one as punishment  <sub>[v3 c5 P13](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0013)</sub>
- Chased Mrs. Lynde's rooster round the yard until it died  <sub>[v3 c5 P13](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0013), [v3 c5 P17](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0017)</sub>
- Frightened Mrs. Lynde with a jack-o'-lantern  <sub>[v3 c5 P17](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0017)</sub>
- Ran away from Sunday School to go fishing with the Cottons  <sub>[v3 c13 P94](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0094), [v3 c22 P25](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0025)</sub>
